prompts.text: Invent a product name that sounds expensive but is useless.
Name a fake app for 'organizing your life' — make it oddly specific.
Invent a name for a startup that turns meetings into podcasts.
Name a product that fixes your Wi-Fi with sheer confidence.
Invent a brand name for a coffee that promises productivity.
Name the next big thing in desk toys.
Invent a name for an AI that does your chores — and your job.
Name a gadget for people who hate gadgets.
Invent a name for a service that delivers snacks to meetings.
Name a fake social platform for teams that hate socializing.
Invent a product name that includes the word 'sync'.
Name the app your team actually needs but no one has built.
